palette_usage.red: 10% - mascot, primary CTA, warnings, MITOS label
palette_usage.gold: 5% - highlight words, numbers, sparkles, FAKTA label
rules: Never put red text on navy for body copy; red is for shapes, badges and CTA buttons.
Highlight max 1-3 words per headline in gold.
Charts: up = success green #48E5AD, down = danger #FF7182; never stock-photo candles as the hero.
Only Plus Jakarta Sans. No script, serif or random display fonts.
Headline max 8 words on cards, max 6 words on video frames.
Labels/eyebrows uppercase with wide tracking, red-pink #FF7182 or gold.

mascot.name: Bull
mascot.character_sheet: Anthropomorphic red bull (#E5283C body, #B71A2D shade), large pink-red muzzle (#F2606C) with two dark nostrils, dark-maroon horns (#5E0E18) sweeping outward then curving up and inward, small dark-red hair tuft between the horns, sideways leaf-shaped ears, confident half-lidded eyes with thick dark brows, friendly smirk. Wears a blue collared shirt (#1B4C8F, collar #2D66B5) with gold buttons. Human-like red hands. Thick navy outline (#0A1633), flat vector, no gradients on the body, no realistic fur.
mascot.personality: Smart, calm, slightly cheeky mentor. Never greedy, never panics; explains risk honestly. Comedic reactions allowed (OverSimplified-style), but he is never the butt of a money-loss joke aimed at the audience.
dont: Do not change body colour, horn shape, shirt colour or proportions.
No money bags, no stacks of cash, no Lamborghini/flex imagery (implies guaranteed profit).
No other mascots or real people/brands; no logos of IDX/OJK used as decoration.

illustration_style.summary: Flat vector editorial illustration in the spirit of Kurzgesagt (geometric shapes, layered depth, soft glows, star-dust particles, limited palette) with OverSimplified-style character acting (big readable gestures, comedic timing).
rules: Topic-specific metaphor every time: 1 central metaphor + 3 supporting props that explain THIS concept.
Layering: deep navy background -> mid blue shapes -> light accents; 1 radial glow behind the focal point.
Thick navy outline (6-8px at 1080w) on characters and key props; background shapes without outline.
Rounded geometry, 8-24px corner radius, no photo textures, no stock charts as the subject.
Leave text-safe margins (see formats) and keep the mascot at the bottom/side, never covering text.
Indonesian market context when relevant (IDX, rupiah, lot = 100 lembar, ARA/ARB, papan pemantauan khusus).

principles: Hook in the first 1.5 s: a question or a surprising number on screen + Bull reaction.
One idea per scene, 3-6 s per scene; on-screen text <= 6 words; captions always on.
Elements enter with pop/slide (ease-out-back 0.35-0.5 s), idle float on props, gentle 3-6% camera push-in.
Cut on the VO sentence boundary; 0.25 s dip-to-navy between scenes.
End card 1.2 s: logo + sahamgorengan.id + follow handle.
motion_style.vo_style: Bahasa Indonesia santai-profesional, kalimat pendek (<= 14 kata), sapaan 'kamu', tanpa slang berlebihan, angka dibaca jelas.

do: Jelaskan mekanisme sebab-akibat, bukan sekadar definisi.
Pakai contoh HIPOTETIS dengan angka sederhana dan asumsi eksplisit.
Akui batasan dan risiko; sebut kapan konsep tidak berlaku.
dont: Janji cuan/profit, 'pasti naik', 'auto kaya', FOMO, urgensi palsu.
Menyuruh beli/jual ticker tertentu (kecuali pilar rekomendasi dengan data+tanggal valid dan disclaimer).
Clickbait yang isinya tidak menjawab judul.

compliance.default_disclaimer: Konten edukasi, bukan ajakan beli/jual atau nasihat investasi personal. Keputusan dan risiko ada di tangan masing-masing.
rules: SG Premium berbayar; komunitas Telegram gratis. Jangan tukar keduanya.
Klaim kinerja historis tanpa audit dilarang.
Setiap fakta pasar/regulasi wajib sumber primer (idx.co.id, ojk.go.id, ksei.co.id, bi.go.id, sikapiuangmu.ojk.go.id) atau media kredibel.
